card.name: Start of a name before its next piece
card.fires_on: Short word-starting letters such as M, Ch, Gr, k or w that begin a name or word whose remainder is still to come. Seen most in the credit line "David Zieve, MD, MHA" and in proper names.

modes.label: MHA after MD
modes.description: The letter M starting the degree MHA in the A.D.A.M. reviewer credit line.
modes.example: David Zieve, MD,<< M>>HA, David R. Eltz,

modes.label: Start of a proper name
modes.description: Ch or Gr beginning a person or place name that is split into pieces.
modes.example: The opening of the quarries at Dingwall and<< Ch>>eticamp meant new economic opportunities

modes.label: Start of a rare word
modes.description: A first letter or two of an uncommon word like grunion or kauri.
modes.example: it's a time for<< gr>>union love.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are car words and the suppressed ones are "ar" pieces, so there is no clear link to the text; the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the first letters of a name or rare word that is still unfinished, especially the M in MHA after a doctor's MD.
